Ginger Ale 355ml (Canada Dry): Pale, fizzy ginger ale, 355ml. Sweet and gentle, with a mild ginger warmth rather than any real bite.
Ginseng & Honey Green Tea (Arizona): Green tea sweetened with honey and ginseng. Light and sweet, with a gentle grassy tea flavour underneath.
Imported Lager Beer 330ml (Stella Artois: A pale European lager, 330ml. Crisp, dry and lightly bitter with a clean finish.
Lager Beer 330ml (Budweiser): A pale American lager, 330ml. Light-bodied, mild and faintly sweet — easy drinking and cold-served.
Malt Beer 330ml (Heineken): A pale Dutch lager, 330ml, in Original and Silver. Crisp and lightly bitter; the Silver is the lighter and softer of the two.
Organic Kombucha 250ml (Remedy): Organic kombucha, 250ml, in peach and passionfruit. Fermented tea — tart, fizzy and dry rather than sweet.
Sun Brewed Style Iced Tea (Arizona): Iced tea in lemon, peach and green tea. Sweet and light, tasting brewed rather than syrupy.
Condensed Soup Cream of Chicken (298g (C: Condensed cream of chicken soup, 298g. Thick and savoury straight from the tin, mild and creamy once let down with liquid.
Cream of Mushroom (Campbell's): Condensed cream of mushroom soup. Thick and earthy from the tin, turning mild and creamy once let down.
Mayonnaise Japanese Style 300g (Kewpie): Japanese-style mayonnaise, 300g. Richer and tangier than Western mayonnaise, with a savoury depth from rice vinegar.
Olive Oil Mayonnaise 887ml (Kraft): Mayonnaise made with olive oil, 887ml. Thick and creamy with a mild tang, a little fruitier than plain mayonnaise.
Signature Instant Oatmeal 500G (Picky Fa: Plain instant oatmeal, 500g. Soft and mild with only a little sweetness — the unflavoured one of the three.
